nodes.description: address public owner of Ownable; set to msg.sender in the constructor and replaced by transferOwnership
uint public totalSupply declared in ERC20; mutated (decremented) by StandardToken.burn
mapping(address => uint) balances; token balances read and written by transfer, transferFrom, burn and TCSCCoin functions
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; allowance table written by approve and transferFrom
mapping(address => bool) public frozenAccount; written by freezeAccount but never consulted by transfer/transferFrom, so frozen accounts are not actually blocked
string public name of the token, set in the TCSCCoin constructor
string public symbol of the token, set in the TCSCCoin constructor
uint public decimals of the token, set in the TCSCCoin constructor
uint public totalSupply redeclared in TCSCCoin, shadowing ERC20.totalSupply; set in the constructor and inflated by mintToken
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance keys and allowance spender keys
Ownable() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner; replaces owner when newOwner != address(0)
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner); _;
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure internal; asserts b <= a and returns a - b
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure internal; computes c = a + b and asserts c>=a && c>=b
SafeMath.sAssert(bool assertion) internal pure; reverts when assertion is false
StandardToken.transfer(address _toAcct, uint _value) public; debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[_toAcct] via safeAdd
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _fromAcct, address _toAcct, uint _value) public; moves balances and decrements the caller allowance using safeSub/safeAdd
StandardToken.balanceOf(address _owner) public constant; returns balances[_owner]
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint _value) public; sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no zero-first requirement
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) public constant; returns allowed[_owner][_spender]
StandardToken.burn(uint256 _value) public; subtracts _value from balances[msg.sender] and from totalSupply
TCSCCoin() constructor; totalSupply = 100 * (10**6) * (10**6), all tokens assigned to msg.sender, name/symbol/decimals set
function () payable public; accepts ether while no withdrawal function exists in the contract
TCSCCoin.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; moves the owner balance to _newOwner and then calls Ownable.transferOwnership
TCSCCoin.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint amount) public onlyOwner; performs ERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, amount) with an owner-supplied target contract
TCSCCoin.freezeAccount(address target, bool freeze) public onlyOwner; writes frozenAccount[target] without any enforcing check elsewhere
TCSCCoin.mintToken(address _toAcct, uint256 _value) public onlyOwner; credits balances and increases totalSupply via safeAdd and emits Transfer events
uint c = a + b inside safeAdd; the addition itself is unchecked and only guarded afterwards by sAssert(c>=a && c>=b)
return a - b inside safeSub; the subtraction is unchecked and only guarded by sAssert(b <= a)
ERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, amount) external call to an owner-supplied contract; return value is returned unchecked to the caller and no reentrancy protection is present
payable fallback that accepts ether with no withdraw/transfer path, so received funds are locked
totalSupply = safeAdd(totalSupply, _value) inside mintToken; the privileged owner can inflate the supply arbitrarily at any time
